en.title: Shackles of the Celestial Sphere and the Forbidden Tome Woven in Twilight
en.premise: A forbidden star chart detailing the "lost constellations" erased from the empire's history. When a young librarian gets his hands on it, the stopped clock of the world begins to tick once more. On the night of a lunar eclipse, the heavenly shackles are undone, and the return of the ancient gods—overwriting the laws of the earth—begins. Defying the chains known as fate, he seeks to carve a new story into the sky.

zh.title: 天球之枷与暮色中缀写的禁书
zh.premise: 记载着被帝国历史抹去的“失落星座”的禁忌星图。当年轻的图书管理员触及这本星图时，世界停滞的时钟再次转动。在月食之夜，天之枷锁解开，意欲重写地上常理的古老神明宣告回归。他抗拒着名为命运的锁链，试图在天空中刻下全新的故事。

prediction_results.question: 包囲されたエリスたちは、この絶体絶命の状況をどう脱する？
